# M7 Mare Nostrum: sink the Warden flagship (Battleship 'flagship') and capture the harbour port (34, 12) of Isle Verdant (Verdant Roads). Start forces: player LAN2 CR2 BS1 SUB1 TCO2 BCO2 INF3 MECH2 (15 units), 2 ports + 1 airport + 1 base, funds 8000; Green Earth Drake (army 2) BS1 (flagship) CR2 SUB2 LAN1 INF2 (hold) (8) + Sensei (army 3, Yellow Comet) FTR3 BCO2 (5), ports + airport to build. The Twin Sisters (the two middle atolls, each ~9x7 cells with woods and a hill) each hold a NEUTRAL airport: north atoll airport (19,5) and the missile silo M (21,4); south atoll airport (19,18). A one-cell spit of sand joins the north atoll to the home island (row 6, x 12..15: the player's infantry walk to it) and the south atoll to Isle Verdant (row 17, x 23..31: the enemy's walk to it); each side must reach the other's atoll by Lander, Copter or Transport (lint AR03 wants a foot route from some HQ; RC04 wants Landers to have land their army cannot walk to). Reefs (r) in clusters of 3 in the channels: (16,10) (17,10) (17,11); (21,13) (22,12) (22,13); (26,2) (27,2) (26,3); (25,19) (26,19) (26,20); (12,21) (13,21) (13,22); the open channel y 10..13 stays clear. Threat -> answer: Sensei's Fighters and Copters -> the two Cruisers (AA) and Fighters built at the player's airport (6, 12); Drake's Battleship -> the player's Battleship and Sub, Bombers from the airport; Subs -> Cruisers (the only ships that see and hit them); landing: shoal beaches on the home island's east coast (x 11..13), the Twin Sisters atolls (shoal ring, 6+ cells) and the whole west coast of Isle Verdant (x 28..34) with sand behind.

# atoll_n: (16, 4) Twin Sisters, north atoll x 15..23, y 2..8: neutral airport (19, 5), missile silo (21, 4)
